hero.sub: Sessions, finances, proposals and deliveries for your studio in one panel. Goodbye spreadsheets and sticky notes.
strip.1s: Your whole studio in one place
strip.2s: Sessions and finances, up to date
cmp.h2: From scattered sheets to a single panel.
cmp.p: What changes in your studio’s day-to-day when you drop the spreadsheets and sticky notes.
cmp.n1: Sessions booked by message or in a notebook.
cmp.n2: Quotes built by hand in Word, from scratch every time.
cmp.n3: Income and expenses scattered across loose spreadsheets.
cmp.n4: Mixes and masters shared over Drive, with no control over who has what.
cmp.a1: A studio calendar with rooms, rates and deposits in one place.
cmp.a2: Branded proposals, generated in minutes from a template.
cmp.a3: Clear income, expenses and profit, always up to date.
feat.h2: Everything a studio needs, without ten separate apps.
feat.p: Ditch the paper and the spreadsheets. Every part of your business, connected and at hand.
feat.sched.p: Studio calendar, rooms, rates and deposits. See what’s coming today and catch double bookings instantly.
feat.fin.p: Monthly income, expenses and profit with charts. Always know what you earned and what you’re owed.
feat.prop.p: Create branded proposals and export them as PDF.
feat.coll.p: Balance reminders ready for WhatsApp and email.
feat.deliv.p: Share mixes and masters with a private link.
dev.p: Nothing to install. Open your browser on your Mac, tablet or phone and your studio is there, always up to date.

show.lead: Build the proposal from a template or with AI help, adjust prices from your catalog and deliver it as a PDF with your studio’s branding.
show.l1: Templates by project type: single, EP, podcast, mixing and mastering.
show.l2: Total calculated automatically, in MXN, USD or EUR.
show.l3: Export to PDF and share it by email or WhatsApp.
price.p: A complete panel for less than what you charge for one session. Special price for the first studios; no lock-in, cancel any time.
price.m.desc: Launch price to get started with no commitment.
price.y.desc: Launch price with the best discount.
faq.q1: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a1: No. It runs in the cloud from your computer or phone browser. You just log in with your username and password.
faq.a2: Yes. Each studio’s information is kept separate and protected, with automatic backups. You own your data and can export it whenever you want.
faq.q3: Can I add my logo and my prices?
faq.a3: Of course. You set up your name, logo and service catalog; proposals and receipts go out with your studio’s branding.
faq.a4: Try the demo to get a feel for it and subscribe to activate your account. We’ll help with the initial setup and loading your first data.
final.h2: Get your studio in order this week.
final.p: Explore the demo with sample data and subscribe when you’re ready.
